documentation.file_docstring: Governance Diagnostic Provider for Agent OS Orchestrates real-time diagnostics for governance-specific policy violations by composing rules from governanceRules, governanceIntegrationRules, and code actions from governanceCodeActions.
inline_comments: Activate the provider and subscribe to document lifecycle events.
Analyze a single document and produce governance diagnostics.
Apply a single rule. Delegates to the rule's custom analyze function if present, otherwise falls back to simple regex matching.
Dispose of all subscriptions and the diagnostic collection.
